items.title: wisphive_hook socket-test harness: fake-daemon teardown race (DaemonUnreachable vs Runtime flake)
acceptance: socket_scenario (or callers) synchronizes so the hook consumes the Error line before the fake daemon drops the socket
socket_error_response_fails_closed and socket_garbage_decision_fails_closed no longer flake under full-workspace parallel load
